prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin to establish rules for [adoption, redesign], [finish, new_flow], [finish, new_screen], and [sign_in, reorder] since each kind of change has only one test so far.
Evidence for [finish, redesign] is mixed across 2 tests: one test won with a +5.4% gain after noise correction, while another showed no clear effect (-1.2% after noise correction).
Predictions were consistently too high for tests that performed poorly and stopped early ([adoption, redesign], [sign_in, reorder], and [finish, new_screen]).
Predictions were too high for [finish, redesign] in round 6, where a predicted +5.0% gain resulted in no clear effect (-1.2% after noise correction).
Predictions were too low for winning tests, including [finish, redesign] in round 4 (predicted +3.0%, actual +5.4% after noise correction) and [finish, new_flow] in round 7 (predicted +2.0%, actual +9.8% after noise correction).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -8.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: +9.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -6.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: +1.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -8.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 79.4%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Customization Live Preview Wizard Flow: Adds a dedicated preview confirmation screen to the adoption sequence so users can test animations and visual accuracy before finalizing their pet. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate (60.9%) and long median duration (89s), while support reports custom pets failing or looking incorrect.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Launch Diagnostic Screen: Inserts a system verification screen during waiting that checks window permissions and rendering stability before final desktop launch. (why: Multiple support emails mention pets failing to appear on desktop or app failing to open during launch, contributing to home step dropoff.)
2: [finish, redesign] Desktop Companion Quick Reference Overview: Redesigns home intro into a split layout showcasing primary mouse shortcuts, taskbar tray controls, and voice commands. (why: Support mails show confusion after onboarding regarding how to hide, control, or interact with the pet.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] Path Choice Carousel Experience: Rebuilds the path choice screen into an interactive carousel contrasting immediate starter adoption against custom pet creation. (why: Choose path has a high mean duration of 514s and 76.2% conversion, indicating decision friction at the outset.)
4: [sign_in, notification] Account Sync Status Notification: Displays an explicit status banner explaining that account creation binds pet data safely to prevent loss upon re-logging. (why: The largest volume of support tickets (8 emails) concerns pets missing or resetting after signing back in.)
5: [adoption, wait_info] Adoption Processing Status Updates: Displays real-time progress indicators and stage hints during pet processing on upload_photos. (why: Adoption has high dropoff (60.9% conversion) and long mean completion times (1017s) when generating custom assets.)
6: [home, wait_info] Background Waiting Tip Carousel: Adds an interactive tip carousel to the waiting screen with desktop hotkey tips while pet assets prepare. (why: The home stage features a long mean wait time (2336s) and user confusion post-onboarding on how to interact with pets.)
7: [sign_in, incentive] Early Cloud Save Starter Badge: Adds an instant cloud save badge highlight on the sign-in screen reinforcing asset preservation. (why: Sign-in step drops conversion to 72.9% with long mean times (567s) due to user hesitation around account setup.)
8: [choose_path, hint] Path Decision Quick Estimate Hint: Shows estimated setup times and path comparison hints directly beneath choice cards. (why: Mean duration on path selection is 514s, indicating users pause without knowing time commitments for each path.)
9: [finish, notification] Post-Setup Desktop Overlay Readiness Notification: Adds a completion status banner on home_intro confirming background taskbar controls and hotkeys. (why: Support receives frequent inquiries about managing, minimizing, or communicating with desktop pets post-onboarding.)

scores.note: Targeted at adoption (lowest 60.9% conv), matches support reports of broken custom pets, but requires a new flow.

Directly targets top support complaint (8 tickets) on sign_in dropoff with a simple banner config.
High impact step (60.9% conv, 1017s mean wait) supported by funnel metrics and support complaints.
Helps pass long home wait time (2336s mean) and informs post-onboarding controls.
